name: uat-mcp
description: Prepare and optimise CAD data locally with the Unity Asset Transformer (pxz) SDK — import, repair, tessellate, decimate, bake, render and export. Requires a Pixyz license seat.

AT_LICENSE_SERVER_HOST.title: Asset Transformer license server host
AT_LICENSE_SERVER_HOST.description: Hostname of the Pixyz license server.

AT_LICENSE_SERVER_PORT.title: Asset Transformer license server port
AT_LICENSE_SERVER_PORT.description: Port of the Pixyz FlexLM license server.

AT_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS.title: Asset Transformer max concurrent jobs
AT_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS.description: Maximum number of heavy Asset Transformer operations (import, prepare, optimise, export, render, bake) allowed to run at the same time in this server, so limited license seats/machines are not overwhelmed. Set 0 for unlimited.

AT_DISABLE_RUN_PYTHON.title: Disable the Asset Transformer run_python tool
AT_DISABLE_RUN_PYTHON.description: Do not offer the run_python tool at all. It executes arbitrary Python inside the Asset Transformer process by design (the at-scripting workflow depends on it), so it is available by default; turn it off on shared or CI machines where nothing should be able to run code as this user. The scene, import, optimise, render and export tools are unaffected.

UAP_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS.title: Restrict file access to these directories
UAP_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS.description: Optional list of directories (separated by ';' on Windows, ':' elsewhere) that every local file this server reads or writes must sit inside — CAD imports, exports, screenshots, renders and recorder dumps. Leave blank (default) to allow any location except credential stores and auto-executed startup files, which are always refused. Plugin settings are per plugin: if you also use the Unity Asset Manager plugin, set the same value there.
